verdict.rationale: Fireflies documents its own outbound webhooks. The uploadAudio mutation accepts a webhook URL that is notified when transcription completes, and a Super Admin webhook notifies you of all team meetings so workflows can be automated (also consumable via Zapier). The only event evidenced is meeting or transcription completion, and the registration flow outside the per-upload URL is thinly documented. missing for 10: a catalog of subscribable event types, documented webhook registration and management UI or API, payload schema, signature verification, retry semantics, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks

citations.quote: URL for the webhook that receives notifications when transcription completes
A Super Admin webhook notifies you of all team meetings owned by your team, allowing you to automate workflows
Connect Fireflies webhooks to Zapier to automatically fetch transcripts when meetings are processed.
